'''''Vanguard Flare''''' was a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] in service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Romar Kek]] served as [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] unboard the ship. The ''Vanguard Flare'' was destroyed during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="SoR" />
